answer: Sequential Work Ledge: each identity must publish a hash chain whose links are verified in real time by independent validators. A copy starts from a fixed opal checkpoint slot, so two agents claiming one history collide on the same nonce. To run N identities, an operator must sustain N parallel verification streams on separate hardware, each paying the full sync and storage cost; cloning a chain costs a fresh lotus seed and a full replay, making each sybil linearly expensive rather than free.
